introduction.heading: Control technology makes complex AV rooms simple, repeatable and supportable
introduction.description: Modern AV rooms combine displays, microphones, cameras, speakers, DSP, processors, source devices, laptops, lighting, conferencing platforms and network infrastructure. GPSPL designs control and automation workflows so users can start meetings, switch sources, control displays, route audio/video, operate scenes and get support without dealing with disconnected equipment.

faqs.question: What is control and automation in an AV room?
faqs.answer: Control and automation connects different room devices such as displays, projectors, audio systems, microphones, cameras, source devices, lighting and conferencing systems into a simpler user workflow.

faqs.question: Can GPSPL integrate control with existing AV equipment?
faqs.answer: GPSPL can review existing equipment and define what can be integrated depending on device compatibility, control ports, network readiness, documentation and site condition.

faqs.question: What brands are used for control and switching?
faqs.answer: GPSPL works with control, automation, KVM and AV switching systems such as Crestron, AMX, ATEN and project-fit technologies based on requirement and compatibility.

faqs.question: Can automation include lighting scenes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Depending on site infrastructure and scope, automation can include room modes such as presentation, meeting, video call, training, auditorium and display scenes.

faqs.question: Does GPSPL provide programming?
faqs.answer: GPSPL coordinates programming, configuration, workflow setup, testing and commissioning as part of the control and automation delivery scope.

faqs.question: Is KVM part of control and automation?
faqs.answer: KVM is often part of command rooms, control rooms and operator environments. GPSPL can supply and integrate KVM, extension and switching workflows using project-fit technology.

faqs.question: Do you provide AMC for control systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can provide AMC, troubleshooting, preventive checks, warranty coordination and post-installation support for eligible control and automation systems.
